title: Smart List & Export Functionality for Member Reviews

content:
## Smart List & Export Functionality for Member Reviews


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079365


## Overview


The Member Reviews page includes tools for exporting reviews and creating Smart Lists based on the current search results.

To access these options, navigate to Interactions → Member Reviews. Then, open the List Actions menu and choose one of the available actions.


## Export Reviews


Select Export Current Results from the List Actions menu to download all reviews that match the current filters.

The exported file is downloaded as a ZIP archive containing a CSV file with the review data.

Note: Exporting member reviews requires the Export Member Data feature. If the feature is not installed, the export option will not be available.

» Export Member Data Add-On

Extract the ZIP file to access the exported reviews in CSV format.


## Creating a Smart List


Select the "Create Smart List from Results" option from the drop-down:

After the Smart List has been created, select Go To Reviews Smart List to view and manage it.
